name: voltage-divider-finder
description: Find the best E-series resistor pairs for voltage dividers, regulator feedback and ADC inputs, with worst-case and Monte Carlo tolerance analysis. Runs in your browser.

paragraphs: Find the best resistor pair for a voltage divider. Give it Vin and the output you want, or a regulator's feedback reference, or an ADC's full-scale voltage. It searches the E-series (E3 to E192), optionally including two-resistor series and parallel combinations, and ranks the pairs by error. It then shows the worst-case and Monte Carlo spread of the real output once the resistor tolerances are applied.
features: Four design modes. A plain divider (Vin to Vout), a regulator feedback divider (Vout = Vref (1 + R1/R2), with common Vref presets), an ADC input (scale the maximum input to the ADC reference, with source impedance and…
E3, E6, E12, E24, E48, E96 and E192, with the standard tables and a default tolerance per series.
Series and parallel combinations of two resistors, for when no single pair is close enough.
Constraints: smallest and largest resistor, minimum and maximum R1 + R2, and a maximum divider current (for battery sensing).
Loaded dividers. A load across R2 is compensated in the search, and the selected pair shows the output with and without the load.
